episodes.title: How a Coronary Angiogram Works Through the Wrist | Right Radial Access
episodes.description:
How does a coronary angiogram reach the heart through the right wrist? Episode 1A of the Elysian Biomedical LLP cardiology series follows a diagnostic angiogram through the right radial artery.

See how a needle and short access wire help place a sheath at the wrist. Follow the diagnostic guidewire and catheter to the aorta, then see how contrast makes the left and right coronary arteries visible on X-ray. The episode also explains how the images inform next steps and what to expect when the team removes the sheath, applies wrist compression and checks recovery.

For general education. Follow your own care team’s instructions about preparation, recovery and when to get help.

episodes.title: How a Coronary Angiogram Works Through the Groin | Right Femoral Access
episodes.description:
How does a coronary angiogram reach the heart through the right groin? Episode 1B of the Elysian Biomedical LLP cardiology series follows a diagnostic angiogram through the right common femoral artery.

See how ultrasound helps locate the artery, how a fine needle and wire establish access and how a temporary introducer and wire exchange allow the working sheath to be placed. Follow the diagnostic catheter to the aorta, watch the left and right coronary contrast runs and see how the images inform next steps. The episode also explains groin closure options, recovery checks and aftercare.

For general education. Follow your own care team’s instructions about preparation, recovery and when to get help.

Original educational animation with simulated angiograms and synthetic English narration.
